{{Top}} {{Character |type=Galactic Empire |image=[[File:Gherant-ROTJ.png]] |name=Gherant |homeworld= |birth= |death=[[4 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' ''[[Executor]]'', [[Endor system]]{{Film|VI}} |species=[[Human]] |gender=[[Gender|Male]]''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'' {{C|Card: Gherant}} |pronouns=He/him |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Brown]] |feathers= |eyes=Blue |skin=Light |cyber= |families=new |parents=new |partners=new |siblings=new |children=new |affiliation=*[[Galactic Empire]] **[[Imperial Navy's officer corps]] **[[Death Squadron]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Too late!|Gherant's final words, during the Battle of [[Endor]]|}} '''Gherant''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Imperial officer|officer]] in the [[Imperial Navy|naval forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. He served on the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] of the [[Super Star Destroyer]] ''[[Executor]]''. ==Biography== {{Quote|We're not going to attack?''"''
''"''I have my orders from the Emperor himself. He has something special planned. We only need to keep them from escaping.|Gherant and Firmus Piett||audio=WereNotGoingToAttack.flac}} Gherant served as an officer in the Imperial Navy during the [[Galactic Civil War]], and was promoted to serve on the bridge of the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought|Super Star Destroyer]] ''Executor'' as a reward for his ambition.''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'' {{C|Card: Gherant}} In [[4 ABY]], when the [[Rebel Alliance Navy]] was trapped by Imperial [[Star Destroyer]]s and the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]] during the [[Battle of Endor]], Gherant questioned [[Fleet Admiral]] [[Firmus Piett]]'s orders to hold when they were informed that the Imperial Navy was in attack position, unaware of [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine's]] plan to use the Death Star's [[superlaser]] to destroy the Rebel fleet. Piett explained that Palpatine had something special planned and that they only needed to keep the Rebels from escaping. [[File:StillObviouslyACar-ROTJ.png|thumb|left|250px|An A-wing crashing into the bridge of the ''Executor'' as Gherant and Piett try to take cover.]] When Rebel [[Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar]] ordered his forces to concentrate all fire on the ''Executor'', two [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor|A-wings]] managed to destroy one of the [[Deflector shield generator dome]]s, causing the bridge to lose its deflector shields. As Piett ordered that forward fire-power be intensified, Gherant pointed at an A-wing piloted by [[Arvel Crynyd]], that had been damaged and sent into an uncontrolled spin. Crynyd maneuvered his starfighter as best as possible and sent it directly at the ''Executor''{{'s}} bridge. As the A-wing flew towards the bridge, Piett yelled again to intensify forward fire-power, to which Gherant remarked "too late!" and jumped into one of the bridge's data pits, followed by Piett as the A-wing crashed through the [[Viewport]]s. The A-wing exploded as it hit the bridge, destroying it and killing the Rebel pilot, along with Gherant, Piett, and the rest of the bridge crew. ==Personality and traits== Gherant was a tall man with brown hair, blue eyes, and light skin. He was ambitious, which earned him a promotion to the ''Executor''. He was also slightly nervous, as seen when questioning Piett's orders to hold, and when frantically looking for incoming starfighters when the bridge's deflector shields were lost during the battle. ==Equipment== Gherant wore the standard issue [[Imperial officer's uniform]] and a [[Rank insignia plaque]] with three red and three blue squares during the Battle of Endor. ==Behind the scenes== Gherant appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] and was played by [[Pip Miller]],{{WebCite|url=https://let-the-wookie-win.com/index.php?showimage=517|text=My Pip Miller Starwars Autograph|author=Oldbury, Dave Louis|date=2011-07-12|work=Star Wars Autograph Collecting|nobackup=1}} with his lines being dubbed by an American actor.{{Blogspot|subdomain=starwarsaficionado|url=2011/11/behind-scenes-image-rebel-surprise.html|name=Star Wars Aficionado Magazine|text=BEHIND THE SCENES IMAGE: REBEL SURPRISE!}} Gherant also appeared in the [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]].[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]] ==Appearances== *{{Film|VI}} {{1st}} *[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]] ==Sources== *{{SWE|characters|admiral-piett|Admiral Piett}} {{Po}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|75|Helmets}} {{Po}} *{{ForceCollection|Gherant|star=3}} {{1stID|Gherant}} *{{Armada|set=Super Star Destroyer Expansion Pack|cardname=Commander Gherant|reprint=1}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Imperial Officers and Agents}} {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Gherant}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Gherant |ja=ゲラント |ko=게란트 |pl=Gherant }} [[Category:Death Squadron personnel]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial Navy officers of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]]
